snippet.title: I HATE SNAKE: Retro Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist I HATE SNAKE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4677990/I_HATE_SNAKE_Retro_Simulator

I HATE SNAKE is Hardcore retro snake game with 80 high-difficulty levels. Features escalating speed, shrinking space, and an algorithm that reacts to player mistakes. Includes a classic high-score mode and customizable 2000s-style phone shells with authentic monochromatic LCD aesthetics.

FEATURES:
🐍 80 Hand-crafted levels of pure reflex-testing chaos.
📈 Escalating Speed: Every 10 levels the clock ticks faster.
📱 Authentic Retro Vibe: Monochromatic LCD and that plastic feel.
🎨 Custom Shells: Classic covers and colors.
🤖 The Demoralizing System: An intelligent algorithm that mocks your failure.

Will you reach Level 80 and silence the machine, or will you prove the game was right about you?

I HATE SNAKE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4677990/I_HATE_SNAKE_Retro_Simulator
